arc_method: net = sum over strikes of (call premium traded - put premium traded), cumulative through the session, from the archived per-minute net-premium grid. Both legs are gross traded premium, so this is NOT the tide's direction-signed net call/put premium; ncp/npp stay null until a per-root signed minute series is archived.
arc_shape_en: built steadily in one direction and stayed

events.label_en: price crossed the gamma flip level
events.label_zh: 价格穿越 gamma 翻转价位

zero_dte.note_en: share of the whole market's running premium total, not this one name
zero_dte.note_zh: 为全市场累计口径，并非该单一标的
zero_dte.thin_note_en: measured on 72 minute(s) where the fullest expiry bucket has 170 — the buckets only overlap for part of the session
zero_dte.thin_note_zh: 仅基于 72 分钟计算，而最完整的到期分组有 170 分钟 —— 各分组仅在部分时段重叠

pockets.note_en: the largest share of the day's running premium total that sat in any three neighbouring strikes
pockets.note_zh: 当日累计权利金中，相邻三个行权价所占的最高比重

walls.note_en: the heaviest call and put strikes finished where they started
walls.note_zh: 最重的看涨与看跌行权价收盘时与开盘时一致

flip.note_en: the gamma flip level is this session's own closing map, so crossings are read against where the day finished
flip.note_zh: gamma 翻转价位取自本交易日收盘结构图，穿越以收盘价位为参照

levels.basis_en: levels read from the end-of-day options map, not from the intraday tape
levels.basis_zh: 价位取自收盘期权结构图，而非盘中成交

market.note_en: market-wide signed tape totals; the sign is a soft read, not confirmed against the quote
market.note_zh: 全市场带方向的成交合计；方向为弱读数，未经报价确认

coverage.quality_en: The intraday record covers only part of the session
coverage.quality_zh: 盘中记录仅覆盖部分交易时段

reliability.note_en: a descriptive record of what the tape and the level map did — no forecast, no ranking, no direction call
reliability.note_zh: 仅为成交与价位结构的记录性描述 — 不含预测、排名或方向判断
